messages.content: How does this ride-sharing app work?

The app connects drivers who have already planned a trip with passengers travelling in the same direction. Drivers schedule trips, and passengers can search for suitable rides and book available seats.
I am driving from Kolenchery to Kochi tomorrow at 10 AM. What should I do?

You can schedule a ride by entering Kolenchery as your starting point, Kochi as your destination, tomorrow's date, and 10 AM as the departure time. Add your available seats and passenger contribution amount, then publish the trip.
Can I book a ride from Kolenchery to Kochi?

Yes. Search for rides from Kolenchery to Kochi and select your preferred departure time. I can help you find matching trips if the app's ride-search service is available. Actual availability must be checked against current ride listings.
How can I find a cheaper ride?
Search for rides matching your route and travel time, then compare the displayed passenger contributions. Choose a suitable ride based on its price, departure time, route, and available seats.
What if no rides are available?
If no matching rides are available, try a nearby departure time or a flexible pickup or drop-off point if the app supports it. You can also check again later when drivers publish new trips.
How many seats are available in a ride?
Seat availability depends on the selected trip's current booking information. I need to check the ride-search service or trip details to provide an accurate number.
Can you book a ride for me?

I can help you choose a suitable ride. Before booking, I need your pickup point, destination, travel date and preferred time. I will check available trips and ask you to confirm the selected ride before submitting a booking through the app.
How do I cancel my booking?

Open your bookings in the app, select the relevant ride, and check whether a cancellation option is available. Review the cancellation terms before confirming. The exact steps and any applicable charges depend on your app's booking policy.
How do I publish a trip as a driver?
Enter your starting point, destination, departure date and time, available seats, and passenger contribution amount. Review the details before publishing your trip.
I want to travel from Kolenchery to Kochi.
I can help you search for a ride from Kolenchery to Kochi. What date and approximate departure time would you prefer?
Are there any seats left in my selected ride?
Seat availability must be checked against the latest booking information. Please select the ride so the app can check its current availability.
Can you guarantee that my ride will be available tomorrow?
I can't guarantee availability in advance. The app must check current ride listings, and availability may change before booking.
The app found no rides for my route.
Sorry, no matching rides were found. You could try a different departure time or a nearby pickup point if the app supports it, or check again later.
Book the cheapest ride for me immediately.
I'll need to search available rides and compare their displayed prices first. I'll show you a suitable option and ask you to confirm before submitting a booking.
I need to cancel my ride.
Open your booking details and check the cancellation option and applicable policy. The app must verify the booking before processing the cancellation.
Can I change my departure time?
That depends on the app's trip-editing rules and your booking status. Check the trip or booking details to see whether changing the departure time is supported.
What if the driver has no available seats?
You can't book a seat that isn't available. Search for another matching trip or try a different departure time.
How much will my ride from Kolenchery to Kochi cost?
The cost depends on the available trips and their displayed passenger contributions. I'll need current ride-search results to give you an accurate price.
I want to go to Kochi.
Sure! Where will you be travelling from, and what date and approximate time would you prefer?
I need a ride tomorrow.
I can help you search for a ride. What are your pickup location, destination, and preferred departure time?
Can I book two seats?
I can help check rides that have at least two seats available. Which route and travel date do you need?
I am travelling alone. Can I book?
Yes, if a suitable ride has an available seat and meets the app's booking rules. Tell me your pickup, destination, and travel date so we can search.
I want to offer a ride to passengers.
You can create a driver trip by entering your route, departure date and time, available seats, and passenger contribution. Review the details before publishing.
Can I publish a trip without a departure time?
A departure time is normally needed to schedule a trip. Enter the intended date and time, or check the app's trip-creation requirements.
I entered the wrong destination.
Please correct the destination before publishing or booking. If the trip or booking has already been submitted, check whether the app allows you to edit it.
Can I book a ride with zero available seats?
No. A ride with zero available seats should not accept another passenger. Search for another trip or a different departure time.
The search is still loading.
The ride search may be taking longer than expected. Wait briefly and try again. If the problem continues, the app should report a search error rather than inventing results.
The ride search failed.
Sorry, I couldn't retrieve the ride results. Please try again. I won't claim that rides are available until the search succeeds.
The app shows no matching rides.
No matching rides were returned for those search details. You could try another departure time or a nearby pickup point if supported.
Is the displayed price guaranteed?
The displayed price is the information currently returned by the app. Check the final price and applicable terms before confirming your booking.
Can you tell me the exact number of available seats?
I need current information for the selected trip to answer accurately. Please select a ride so the app can check its latest seat availability.
Book it without showing me the details.
I can help with the booking, but you should review the selected ride, price, route, and departure time before confirming.
I changed my mind. Don't book it.
No booking should be submitted unless you confirm it. If you haven't confirmed, we can stop here.
Can you cancel another passenger's booking?
I can only help with actions authorized for your account. The app must verify your permissions before allowing a cancellation.
I cannot access my booking.
Check that you're signed in to the correct account. If the booking still isn't visible, the app should help you troubleshoot or contact support.
Can I edit a trip after publishing it?
That depends on the app's trip-editing rules and whether the trip has bookings. Check the trip details before making changes.
What if the driver cancels?
Check the app for the latest booking status and any cancellation or refund guidance. The actual outcome depends on the app's policies.
Can I share my OTP with the driver?
Don't share login or verification OTPs with a driver. Use only the app's official verification process.
എനിക്ക് കൊച്ചിയിലേക്ക് പോകണം.
തീർച്ചയായും! നിങ്ങൾ എവിടെ നിന്നാണ് യാത്ര തുടങ്ങുന്നത്? യാത്രയുടെ തീയതിയും ഏകദേശ സമയവും പറയാമോ?
Kolenchery ninnu Kochi vare ride venam.
Sheri, Kolenchery-il ninnu Kochiyilekku ride therayan sahayikkam. Eth date-il aanu pokendathu? Approximate time parayamo?
Nale morning ride kittumo?
ലഭ്യമായ rides ഉറപ്പാക്കാൻ app-ൽ ഇപ്പോഴത്തെ listings പരിശോധിക്കണം. ഏത് സ്ഥലത്ത് നിന്നാണ് യാത്ര തുടങ്ങേണ്ടത്, എവിടേക്കാണ് പോകേണ്ടത്?
Enikku 3 seats venam.
മൂന്ന് seats ലഭ്യമുള്ള ride കണ്ടെത്താൻ route-ഉം യാത്രാ തീയതിയും പറയൂ. നിലവിലെ seat availability app പരിശോധിക്കണം.
Can I pay the driver directly?
Payment options depend on the app's actual payment policy. Check the payment instructions shown for your selected ride before paying.
The driver is late.
Check the trip status and contact options provided in the app. If needed, contact support; I can't confirm the driver's location without live trip data.
Can you track the driver live?
Live tracking is possible only if the app provides it and the relevant location data is available. Open your active trip to check.
I want a ride at 10 AM, but the date is not fixed.
What date are you planning to travel? Once you provide the date, we can search for rides around 10 AM.
Can I reserve a seat for my friend?
That depends on the app's booking rules. Check whether your account can book multiple seats and make sure the correct number of seats is selected.
What information do you need to search for a ride?
Please provide your pickup location, destination, travel date, and preferred departure time. I can then help search for matching rides.
The booking button is not working.
Please check your connection and try again once. If the issue continues, the app should report the booking error. Avoid submitting repeated requests if you aren't sure whether a booking succeeded.
